verdict.rationale: Capacities' built-in AI assistant answers from your notes, can plan multi-step work, and proposes creates and updates for you to approve (capacities-docs-42). You can open chats from Explore or a shortcut and pass notes as context (capacities-docs-23). Chat Connectors and an official MCP server also let ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Le Chat operate on the space through natural language (capacities-docs-3, capacities-docs-17, capacities-probe-3). Missing for 10: documentation of which actions natural-language commands can perform beyond creating and updating content (e.g., navigation, settings, task actions); independent or hands-on corroboration that this works in practice.
